test: Record a click through the loop cable and compare its position with the pulse grid
notes: Residual was +2102 frames with no compensation; the shift is exactly the configured latency

conclusion: then record clicks and compare with the grid

conclusion: play a loop and read the correlation result

test: Read snd_pcm_hw_params_get_buffer_size on both of the firmware's handles and compare a click recording against the pulse grid
notes: 1024+1024 frames gave a 69-frame (1.6 ms) residual; snd_pcm_delay and snd_pcm_avail both report 0 on this device so they cannot be the source

hypothesis: The read/write stream counters give the latency directly
test: Sample the counters at many phases while a loop plays
notes: The difference swings by thousands of frames within a callback and averages differently per phase

test: Set the knob and measure the loop level in the output tap
notes: Without compensation the level was constant 0.150 rms at every knob position; applying value/127 to the mix gives 0.118 at 100 and 0.076 at 64

hypothesis: The channel count for mixing must come from the device's own hw params, not from whichever set_channels call was seen last
test: Read snd_pcm_hw_params_get_channels on both streams and compare with g_pcm_channels
notes: Both report 4 in the lab while a single shared counter could disagree between streams on the device and overrun a narrower buffer
